metadata.description: Local text to static GLB generation on an AMD Strix Halo iGPU

plugins.name: text-to-3d
plugins.description: Turns one subject description into a static textured GLB on a Strix Halo iGPU. The skill initializes ComfyUI, a resident Vulkan TRELLIS.2 engine, and the local preview gallery, then generates to an optional face-count target.
